title: Hardcore Item Revive
description: This project adds the functionality to revive a player on a hardcore server by right clicking a nether star and then choosing the player you want to revive. (Ensure "hardcore" is set to true in server.properties before creating the server)
body:
This plugin works with hardcore mode allowing a player to right click (or left click) a nether star, which opens a gui menu allowing them to select a dead player they want to revive. When a player is revived they will spawn back at the world spawn as if they died in normal survival mode. The revival item in this version cannot be changed (future update).

For the plugin to work, you must set hardcore mode to true in server.properties as it is designed for hardcore mode.
